findings.title: The embedding server engram starts keeps running after every CLI command exits, although the README says engram stops it
Existing indexes keep wrong symbol bodies for files with form feeds or Unicode line separators; index and --reembed-code do not repair them
engram pack copies hard-coded secrets from unrelated files' module context into the review pack word for word
A repo registered under a symlinked path is reported as not registered by repo-scoped commands run inside it
engram status exits 0 and looks healthy while the configured embedding model does not match the store
First index on a new machine downloads 27 MB of tree-sitter grammars, but the README says the only off-machine call is the model download
A full index or rebuild takes about 2.1x as long since module context was added
Pack code excerpts lose indentation after the first line, so file text can forge Markdown headings and findings in the review pack
With a mismatched model configured, query starts a llama-server for the wrong model, fails, and leaves it running
Top-level-only scripts in Ruby, PHP, Perl, R, Elixir, Scala, C#, Dart and zsh get no module context and are left out of the code corpus
The README Corpora table still says code is one chunk per function or class, omitting module context
index and status print an unlabeled discovery:<repo> line on stdout
Every indexed file and every MCP call sends an extra ping embedding request
A lookup --name that finds nothing does about 69% more work because the prefix fallback scans module-context rows

findings.downgraded: claimed verified; evidence quoted file headings and named no command run
findings.title: CHANGELOG has a second Added/Fixed pair under one [Unreleased] heading with no version heading between
The vector table reserves about 4 MiB per repo and corpus, so the store grows about 12.8 MB per registered repo regardless of content
